prompt:
bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, twelve phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.9 (Renewal limits) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.9's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `LoanDesk.renewals_left` reports how many renewals a loan has left (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_renewals_left`)
`renew` refuses with `LimitReached` while another member has a hold on the book (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_renew_holds`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `LoanDesk.renewals_left` is added to shelf/loans.py and returns policy.MAX_RENEWALS minus the loan's renewals (tests/test_renewals_left.py).
renewals_left finds the loan through LoanDesk._loan, so an unknown loan id raises NotFound.
`renew` raises LimitReached while another member has a hold on the loan's book (desk.holds.queue), tested in tests/test_renew_holds.py.
A hold placed by the borrower themself does not block the renewal.
renew keeps its existing checks: returned loans, overdue loans and MAX_RENEWALS.
Tasks touch only shelf/ and tests/.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
